nav.sidebarHint: Compliance workspace — roles and data from your organization.

dashboard.title: Compliance overview
dashboard.intro: Each area below maps to obligations under the Working Environment Act and related rules. Configuration, copy, and permissions live in the database and Supabase policies—not in the application code.
dashboard.overviewPlaceholder: Activity and status charts will appear here when modules are connected.
dashboard.quickTaskDesc: Track statutory duties, deadlines, and checklists.
dashboard.quickInviteDesc: Send an invitation with a role from organization settings.
dashboard.pendingEmpty: No pending items. Tasks and signatures will show here when available.

modules.tasksDesc: Follow-up actions, deadlines, and evidence for statutory duties.
modules.workCouncilDesc: Meetings with fixed agendas, participants, minutes, voting, and audit trail.
modules.hseDesc: Health, safety, and environment registers aligned with the internal control duty.
modules.documentsDesc: Handbooks, risk assessments, and procedures with structured pages and uploads.
modules.surveysDesc: MAP and other surveys to assess and improve the psychosocial environment.
modules.reportsDesc: Confidential reporting channel with case handling and access control.
modules.learningDesc: Courses with rich content, quizzes, flash cards, and JSON import/export.
modules.settingsDesc: Invitations, roles, locales, and integration settings.

modules.tasksPlaceholder: Task templates, assignments, due dates, and checklist items are stored per organization. Connect this view to Supabase queries and mutations.
modules.workCouncilPlaceholder: Plan meetings, enforce agenda order, record attendance, append-only audit log, and run ballots for elected roles—all scoped to your organization.
modules.hsePlaceholder: Risk assessments, inspections, incidents, and action tracking with RLS tied to HSE roles.
modules.documentsPlaceholder: Hierarchical wiki spaces, versioned rich text (same editor as courses), and file attachments in Supabase Storage with metadata in Postgres.
modules.surveysPlaceholder: Anonymous or identified surveys, recurring campaigns, and reporting for the psychosocial working environment.
modules.reportsPlaceholder: Report intake, triage workflow, and strict separation of duties for reviewers.
modules.learningPlaceholder: Author courses, add flash cards, short messages, media blocks, and quizzes; export and import course definitions as JSON for admins.
modules.settingsPlaceholder: Organization profile, locales, invitations, and role assignments mapped to legal responsibilities.

hse.voHint: As safety representative (VO), you can view all HSE records in the organization, run inspections, escalate deviations to AMU, and release halt-work locks.
hse.rosIntro: Use probability and consequence (1–5). The system computes risk and flags medium/high ROS for action plans.
hse.deviationsIntro: Report deviations with category, description, and proposed measures. VO can escalate to the AMU agenda.
hse.inspectionsIntro: Run checklist templates (vernerunder). Failed items create deviation records automatically.
hse.noTemplates: No inspection templates for this organization.
hse.inspectionRunHint: Mark each item pass, fail, or not applicable. For failed items, choose category and describe the deviation before saving the inspection.
hse.inspectionAnswerAll: Answer every checklist item before saving.
hse.deviationDescriptionRequired: Describe the deviation for each failed item.
hse.inspectionFailDescriptionPlaceholder: What was observed and immediate risk…
hse.haltIntro: Register a halt with area and equipment context. VO can release the lock when safe. SMS/email alerts require a notification integration.
hse.whistleblowerIntro: Submit a confidential report. Anonymous submissions do not store your user id on the case.
hse.whistleblowerSubmitted: Report received. Reference code is shown to reviewers.
hse.whistleblowerRbacHint: Anonymous cases are visible only to the whistleblowing reception group and designated reviewers—not to general managers.
hse.whistleblowerInboxDenied: You do not have access to the whistleblowing inbox.
hse.haltAlertHint: After save, an alert job record is created for configured CEO emails. SMS/email delivery requires a worker or integration.
hse.haltVoOnlyCreate: Only the elected safety representative (VO) can register a formal halt work entry.
hse.actionPlanAssigneeRequired: Choose an assignee for the action plan.
hse.closeBlockedActionPlan: You cannot close this risk assessment until an action plan task is linked (required for medium/high risk).
hse.uploadUnsupported: Only PNG, JPG, GIF, WebP, or PDF files are allowed.
hse.haltReleaseVoOnly: Only the safety representative (VO) can release a halt.

survey.actionPlanModalIntro: Create a follow-up task linked to this survey and department.
survey.adminIntro: Publish draft surveys or close active ones. Template pulse and culture surveys are created per organization.
survey.noPublishedSurveys: No published surveys yet. Ask an administrator to publish a survey.
survey.noQuestions: This survey has no questions yet.
survey.anonymityHidden: Data hidden to protect employee anonymity (minimum {min} responses required; current: {count}).
survey.psychSafetyRisk: Psychological safety risk: aggregate score is below the threshold.
survey.actionPlanPrompt: Low scores — create an action plan
survey.noTrend: Historical trend appears when you compare survey rounds over time.
survey.analyticsIntro: Aggregated metrics only. Raw responses are not shown to managers.
survey.noManagedDepartments: You are not assigned as a department manager. Ask an administrator to grant access.

hseSettings.haltAlertsHint: Comma-separated email addresses notified when the VO registers a halt (§ 6-3). Connect an email/SMS worker to the hse_halt_alert_outbox table for production delivery.

compliance.title: Legal mapping (data-driven)
compliance.subtitle: These rows are seeded from the Working Environment Act structure. Extend or edit them in the database; the UI only reads them.
compliance.amu_committee_members: AMU committee members (employer and employee representatives) are listed in the AMU center roster. The safety representative (VO) is synced from roles and cannot be removed from the roster by mistake.
compliance.amu_sign: Meeting protocols can be finalized as PDF and sent for digital signature (e.g. BankID). Signed documents are stored for compliance audits.

auth.loginSubtitle: Use your work email and password.
auth.registerSubtitle: You will be the organization administrator. You can invite teammates afterward.
auth.slugHint: Lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens. Used in URLs.
auth.authError: Sign-in failed. Try again or request a new link.
auth.confirmEmail: Check your email to confirm your account, then sign in.
auth.inviteRegisterHint: Use the same email address the invitation was sent to.
auth.onboardingSubtitle: You are signed in but not yet linked to an organization.
auth.invalidSlug: Use a valid slug: at least 2 characters, lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens only.
auth.inviteAlreadyHaveAccount: Already have an account? Sign in
auth.inviteMissingToken: This link is missing the invitation token.
auth.inviteExpiredOrInvalid: This invitation is invalid or has expired. Ask your administrator for a new invite.

lms.contentFromOtherLocale: Shown in {language} — not translated for the current language yet.
lms.catalogIntro: Default courses for every organization appear first; your company can add its own published courses below.
lms.acBanner: Hi {name}, need help setting up learning or a walkthrough? Talk with your administrator or schedule a session.
lms.acWelcomeTitle: Welcome, {name}! Let's get started with your training.
lms.acEmptyTitle: No courses in the catalog yet
lms.acEmptyBody: Ask your administrator to publish default courses or create organization courses in the studio.
lms.acFeaturedFallback: Open the course overview to see modules, prerequisites, and enrollment.
lms.acVideoTagline: Learn in short steps — video, documents, and quizzes in one place.
lms.pdWelcomeSubtitle: Browse published courses, continue where you left off, or open the studio to author new training.
lms.pdCard1Desc: AML, participation, and HSE in one structured path.
lms.pdCard2Desc: Micro-lessons and checklists you can apply the same week.
lms.pdCard3Desc: Quizzes and reflections to verify understanding.
lms.pdCard4Desc: Completion records when your org enables certification.
lms.pdBanner: Hi {name} — need help with learning setup or enrolment? Contact your org administrator.
lms.needOrg: Join or create an organization to see the catalog.
lms.noSystemCourses: No default courses yet. A platform administrator can publish system courses.
lms.noCompanyCourses: No organization courses yet. Authors can add them in the studio.
lms.studioIntro: Design courses with modular blocks (quiz, flash cards, micro-lessons, and more). Publish when ready.
lms.studioDefaultCatalogForExportIntro: Published catalog courses appear here so you can open them and copy JSON for your own organisation course. Editing the live catalog requires a platform administrator.
lms.readOnlySystemCourse: This is a published default course: you can export JSON and preview sections. You cannot change the live catalog version.
lms.noAuthorAccess: You need the learning author role or org admin to edit company courses.
lms.platformAdminHint: To manage default courses for all companies, your user must be listed in the platform_admins table (run in SQL as a superuser).
lms.slugAutoHint: A short URL-friendly code is created automatically from your title. You do not need to type it.
lms.titleRequired: Enter at least one title (Norwegian or English).
lms.titlesOptional: Titles and descriptions are optional per language. Learners see a clear message if a field is missing in their language.
lms.titleEnPlaceholder: e.g. Work environment for new managers
lms.errorSchemaCache: The database is missing the latest LMS columns (for example scope). Run migration 20250326220000_learning_lms.sql in the Supabase SQL editor, then wait a minute and try again.
lms.scopeHelp: System courses are visible to all members once published. Only platform admins can create or edit them.
lms.jsonPlaceholder: Paste exported JSON to replace all sections…
lms.resourceLibraryIntro: Register shared files and links (PDF, video, SCORM, H5P, etc.). Attach to modules via learning_module_resources in the database or future picker UI.
lms.resourceUrlHint: Use a public HTTPS URL or a signed Supabase Storage URL after upload.
lms.dragDropHint: Drag the handle on each section to reorder. Positions save automatically.
lms.prerequisitesHelp: Learners must complete the selected organization courses before they can open this course. Only organization courses in the same org can be linked.
lms.completePrerequisitesFirst: Complete the courses below before continuing.
lms.contentLocked: This section is not available yet.
lms.certificateRecorded: Certificate issued. PDF generation can be wired to storage later.
lms.assignmentUploadHint: Full submission workflow with grading and plagiarism hooks can connect here.

documents.title: Document center
documents.intro: Hierarchical wiki pages, version history, full-text search, and optional approval before publishing. Content and permissions are stored in the database.
documents.setupError: Could not prepare the document space.
documents.migrationHint: Apply migration 20250326240000_wiki_document_center.sql (or the bundled ALL_MIGRATIONS.sql) in Supabase.
documents.askWikiAuthor: Ask an organization administrator or someone with wiki authoring rights to open the document center once; that creates the shared space for everyone.
documents.selectPage: Select a page from the tree or search.
documents.hintVersioning: Every save creates a new revision; compare versions or roll back from History.
documents.hintTemplates: Use SOP, technical, or meeting note templates when creating a page.
documents.hintReview: Set review intervals to surface stale documents.
documents.requiresApproval: Require org admin approval before publishing
documents.bannerDraft: Draft — visible to editors and the page owner.
documents.bannerPending: Pending approval — visible to editors and organization administrators.
documents.reviewDue: This page is due for review. Update content and publish a new revision.
documents.libraryIntro: Wiki articles and uploaded files appear together. Filter by type and category, sort the list, and use actions to view, edit, or remove items.
documents.libraryDbHint: Run migration 20250327120000_document_library.sql (or the latest ALL_MIGRATIONS.sql) to enable file uploads and the library table.
documents.deleteWikiConfirm: Delete this wiki page and all its revisions? This cannot be undone.
documents.deleteFileConfirm: Delete this file from the library and storage?
documents.uploadTitlePlaceholder: Optional display name (defaults to file name)
documents.uploadFormatsHint: Allowed: PDF, Office documents, text, images, ZIP, and common formats (max 50 MB per file).
documents.uploadUnsupportedType: This file type (.{ext}) is not allowed.

amu.intro: Working Environment Committee (AMU): elections, roster, meetings, binding resolutions, and annual reporting. Data is stored in your organization database.
amu.migrationHint: Apply migration 20250328100000_amu_center.sql (or the latest ALL_MIGRATIONS.sql) in Supabase to enable AMU tables and RPCs.
amu.chairRotationBody: Norwegian practice requires the committee chair to alternate between employer and employee sides. Confirm when roles have been reassigned for this year.
amu.quickElectionsDesc: Nomination and voting phases with election protocol.
amu.quickMeetingsDesc: Schedule meetings and generate statutory agenda items.
amu.quickHseDesc: Review HSE records; VO can escalate to AMU.
amu.rosterIntro: Employer and employee representatives. The verneombud (VO) row is synced from the member who holds the safety representative role.
amu.rosterVoHint: Assign the verneombud via organization roles, then use Sync. Editors manage other roster rows in the database or future admin tools.
amu.electionsIntro: Create elections with nomination and voting phases. Set deadlines; past voting end dates auto-close and generate the protocol. Your vote is stored only as an anonymous tally (not linked to your name in the UI).
amu.phaseDeadlineOverdue: Deadline passed — advance phase or close the election.
amu.electionSecretHint: Votes are stored per user for eligibility only; reporting shows counts and winner. Full anonymity would require a dedicated ballot service.
amu.meetingsIntro: Plan AMU meetings (minimum four per year). Generate a statutory agenda and track HSE context.
amu.minutesEditorHint: Real-time minutes editor, PDF protocol, and digital signatures can be wired to storage and a signing provider in a follow-up.
amu.minutesRealtimeHint: Live multi-user editing can be added with Supabase Realtime or Yjs.
amu.protocolVaultHint: PDF generation, attendee signatures, and a read-only legal vault require storage and a signing integration.
amu.hseStatsHint: Open = status open; incidents and ROS use HSE record types (deviation module).
amu.resolutionsIntro: Legally binding AMU decisions—assign an owner, set a deadline, and move cards across the board.
amu.resolutionAlertsHint: Email or push alerts to the CEO and chair when a deadline passes require a notification integration.
amu.reportsIntro: Generate a summary for the board from meetings, HSE activity, and completed resolutions.
amu.hseVoEscalateHint: As verneombud, you can escalate serious deviations to the next AMU meeting agenda.

editor.question: Question
editor.wikiEmptyBlocks: Add blocks with the buttons above.
editor.richTextHint: Formatting is saved as HTML. Use JSON tab for raw edits.

settingsInvites.invitesSubtitle: Create a secure link for a specific email and role. Only organization administrators can send invites.
settingsInvites.inviteCreated: Invitation created. Copy the link and send it to the person (email delivery can be added later).
settingsInvites.invitesAdminOnly: Only organization administrators can manage invitations.
